description:
List the user's stock portfolio holdings.

    Returns each position (shares, average cost, current price, market
    value, profit/loss, weight) from brokerage-linked and manually
    entered trades, plus totals. Use this when the user asks what they
    own or how their positions are doing. Don't use it for a public
    ticker the user doesn't own (use stock_analysis).

    Limits: requires sign-in. Prices are cached snapshots that can be up
    to 7 days old; positions without a price are labeled, never guessed.
    Users with no holdings yet see a demo portfolio, clearly labeled.
name: list_portfolio

Position.description:
One holding in the caller's portfolio (manual entry OR
Plaid-synced brokerage position). Merged view — matches the web
/portfolio page shape.

`price_source` documents where `current_price` came from:
  - `broker_derived`: computed as `market_value / shares` where
    `market_value` is Plaid-reported (fresh as of last brokerage
    sync). Plaid doesn't send `current_price` directly — we
    derive it, and this label says so honestly.
  - `cached_snapshot`: read from stock_snapshot_cache (up to
    7 days old; cache-refresh worker keeps it warm hourly).
  - `cache_miss`: no price available; `current_price` is None
    and `market_value` falls back to shares × avg_cost so
    totals still make sense.
  - `demo_snapshot`: BUG-57 (2026-08-25) — position belongs to
    the shared demo portfolio (signed-in-empty tenant funneled
    to anon pool) and price came from the reference-price map
    baked into `_DEMO_PORTFOLIO_POSITIONS`. Honest label so
    callers know this isn't a live market snapshot. Only appears
    on PortfolioResult rows where `demo_mode=True`.

Anti-BUG-24 discipline: no hardcoded fallback values. Empty is
honest; unknown price is honest. Never fake data.
Position.title: Position

outputSchema.description:
Return type for `list_portfolio()`. Rich shape matching web
/portfolio: positions + totals + source split.

`is_empty` is the explicit signal for empty-tenant / anonymous
callers — LLMs use it to distinguish "no holdings yet" from
"engine failure". Post-BUG-24: NEVER return fake positions;
empty state must render as empty state.
outputSchema.title: PortfolioResult

title: List My Portfolio Holdings
